table2_F_vs_Jratio_maxdev.note: printed F against the ratio of printed fluxes, each printed to three significant digits: rounding alone reaches a few 1e-3

fig_charge_dev_unpromoted_max.note: charge balance of the dashed bulk readings against [K+] = 2 c_carb; the reading resolution is a few mol/m3 on thousands

fig_charge_dev_promoted_max.note: charge balance of the solid bulk readings, the same reading resolution

physical_E1.note: all reactions off: E = 1 for any conservative scheme on a linear profile

pfo_max_rel_err.note: graded n_x = 400 film against the closed form over Ha 0.1 to 300; set by the second-order discretisation of the thinnest reaction layer

second_order_cross.note: two assemblies of the same problem on the same grid; their gap is the Newton tolerances, 1e-8 mol/m3 and 1e-11

vkh_dev.note: the film against the Van Krevelen-Hoftijzer approximation at the DEA Hatta number; the approximation error there is of order 1e-4

collapse_residual.note: the reverse term of reaction (2) at K_eq scaled by 1e6 is of order 1e-5 of the forward rate

carbon_flux_closure.note: every reaction conserves carbon, so the carbon flux is uniform up to the Newton residual

amine_flux_closure.note: every reaction conserves the amine count and the amine is non-volatile

charge_flux.note: charge-conserving reactions and only neutral CO2 through the interface: zero on every face up to the Newton residual, for any diffusivities

electroneutrality.note: equal ion diffusivities and electroneutral Dirichlet data: zero up to the Newton residual

grid_delta.note: E of HDA at alpha = 0.2 on 800 against 400 cells, held two decades below the reproduction deviations it supports

kinst_delta.note: E of HDA at alpha = 0.2 with one more decade of k_inst, held two decades below the reproduction deviations

gas_side_fraction.note: m E k_L/k_g at the largest E of the reconstructed run: the share of the resistance the Dirichlet interface drops

cases_below_ceiling.note: E over its instantaneous ceiling, the twelve reconstructed cases

pen_time_order.note: backward Euler; the order farthest from 1 over the two triples of the n_t ladder 160 to 1280

pen_ladder_over_newton_tol.note: finest successive difference of the ladder over the Newton step tolerance per level: the orders measure the time step, not the solver
